lines.mn: line – ek lakeer, straight line kheench do

logic.mn: logic – dimaag ka logo, reasoning se chalta hai

looking.ex: She is looking at the stars.
looking.mn: looking – aankh se dekhna, look karo

laboratory.ex: The chemist worked in the laboratory.
laboratory.mn: laboratory – labour karke experiment karte lab mein

lackadaisical.ex: His lackadaisical attitude annoyed the boss.
lackadaisical.mn: lackadaisical – 'lack of' josh, sust aur laaparwah

lifeless.ex: The desert looked lifeless under the harsh sun.
lifeless.mn: life-less – jisme life nahi, bilkul murda

lily-livered.ex: The lily-livered soldier ran from the battle.
lily-livered.mn: lily-livered – jiska liver lily jaisa pale, darpok

linguist.ex: The linguist spoke seven languages fluently.
linguist.mn: linguist – lingua yaani zabaan ka expert

literary.ex: She won a prestigious literary award.
literary.mn: literary – literature se juda, letters ki duniya

liveing.mean: a common wrong spelling of living
liveing.ex: The correct spelling is living, not liveing.

loaf.mean: a shaped mass of baked bread
loaf.ex: He bought a fresh loaf of bread.
loaf.mn: loaf – ek pura bread ka lambaa tukda

local.mean: relating to a particular area or place
local.ex: We ate at a popular local restaurant.
local.mn: local – locality ki jagah ka, wahi ka

long.ex: It was a long and tiring journey.
long.mn: long – jo lamba ho, chhota nahi

loosen.ex: He loosened his tie after work.
loosen.mn: loosen – loose kar do, dhila kar do

losses.ex: The company suffered heavy losses this year.
losses.mn: losses – bar bar loss, nuksaan hi nuksaan

love.ex: Their love grew stronger over time.
love.mn: love – pyaar, dil ka gehra lagaav

loyal.ex: A loyal dog stays by its owner.
loyal.mn: loyal – law ko maanne wala, wafadar

ludicrous.mn: ludicrous – ludo khel jaisa bewkoofi bhara, hasyaspad

lulling.ex: The gentle rocking was lulling the baby to sleep.
lulling.mn: lulling – lori sunakar bacche ko sula dena

lurch.mn: lurch – lachak kar achanak jhatka lagna

luxry.ex: My friend wrote 'luxry' instead of 'luxury' in the exam.

lyric.mean: words of a song; short expressive poem
lyric.ex: The lyric of that song is beautiful.
lyric.mn: lyric – lyre baja kar gaaye gaane ke bol

lag.mean: to fall behind or move slowly
lag.ex: He always lags behind the group on hikes.
lag.mn: lag – net slow ho to game 'lag' karta hai, peeche reh jata hai

languid.ex: She gave a languid wave from the hammock.
languid.mn: languid – lang (lambi) neend ke baad body slow aur sust

lapse.ex: A momentary lapse in focus cost him the match.
lapse.mn: lapse – laapse memory, ek chhoti si galti ho gayi

late.ex: He was late for the meeting again.
late.mn: late – 'late lateef' hamesha der se aata hai

latitude.mean: freedom to act; geographic width lines
latitude.ex: The manager gave her latitude to make decisions.
latitude.mn: latitude – lat (wide) area, boss ne kaam mein khuli chhoot di

laudatory.ex: The review was full of laudatory remarks.
laudatory.mn: laudatory – 'loud' taaliyan bajakar sabne tareef ki

laureate.ex: She is a Nobel laureate in physics.
laureate.mn: laureate – Nobel laureate ko laurel (samman) ka taaj milta hai

lax.ex: Security was too lax at the entrance.
lax.mn: lax – rules relax, teacher lax thi to sab masti karte

leader.ex: A good leader listens to the team.
leader.mn: leader – neta jo aage lead karke sab ko chalata hai

leave.mean: to go away from a place
leave.ex: They leave for the airport at noon.
leave.mn: leave – office se 'leave' lekar ghar chala gaya

legacy.mean: something handed down from the past
legacy.ex: He left a lasting legacy of kindness.
legacy.mn: legacy – dada ki legacy, purani virasat aage badhi

legible.mn: legible – 'leg' se nahi haath se likho to legible padhne yogya hoga

leisure.ex: She reads novels in her leisure time.
leisure.mn: leisure – 'le sir' aaram karo, khali time me maze karo

leniently.mean: in a merciful, not strict way
leniently.ex: The teacher treated the latecomers leniently.
leniently.mn: leniently – 'lenient' judge ne narmi se halki saza di

lethargy.ex: After lunch a heavy lethargy set in.
lethargy.mn: lethargy – 'let her go' so jaao, poori sustii chha gayi

lexicography.ex: He devoted his life to English lexicography.
lexicography.mn: lexicography – 'lexicon' likhna, dictionary banane ka kaam

liberate.ex: The army liberated the captured town.
liberate.mn: liberate – 'liberty' do, qaidi ko azaad kar diya

licentious.ex: The novel depicts a licentious lifestyle.
licentious.mn: licentious – 'license' leke sab kuch, besharm aur behad azaad chaal

loony.ex: That loony scheme will never work.
loony.mn: loony – lunar (chaand) dekh ke pagal ho gaya

laggard.mean: one who falls behind; slow person
laggard.ex: The laggard finished the race last.
laggard.mn: laggard – jo peeche 'lag' jaaye, sabse slow

laser.mean: device emitting focused, intense light beam
laser.ex: The doctor used a laser to remove the mole.
laser.mn: laser – patli tez roshni ki 'ray' jo cut kare

leading.ex: She is a leading expert in genetics.
leading.mn: leading – sabko 'lead' karke aage chalne wala

left.mean: the side opposite to right; departed
left.ex: Turn left at the next signal.
left.mn: left – right ke ulta, dil wala side

let.mean: to allow or permit; to rent
let.ex: Please let me finish my work.
let.mn: let – 'let me go' – jaane do, permission do

last choice.mean: the option you pick when nothing else works
last choice.ex: Eating plain rice was my last choice for dinner.

last course of action.mean: final step you take to solve a problem
last course of action.ex: Calling the police was our last course of action.

last friend remaining.mean: the only friend still with you
last friend remaining.ex: When everyone left, Rahul was her last friend remaining.

last hotel on the way.mean: the final hotel before your destination
last hotel on the way.ex: The last hotel on the way had no rooms left.

last resort.mean: the final option when nothing else works
last resort.ex: Borrowing money was his last resort to pay fees.

last ride.ex: Friends carried him on the last ride to the cremation ground.

laughing with inhibition.ex: Sita burst out laughing with inhibition during the function.

laziness is not good.mean: being lazy is a bad habit for everyone
laziness is not good.bn: অলসতা ভালো নয়, এটা খারাপ অভ্যাস
laziness is not good.ex: Maa always says laziness is not good for students.

lead an army.mean: to be the main commander of soldiers
lead an army.ex: General Rawat used to lead an army of brave soldiers.

lead someone by the nose.mean: to fully control someone as you wish
lead someone by the nose.ex: The clever boy led his friend by the nose into trouble.

leave a clue.mean: to give a small hint to solve a mystery
leave a clue.ex: The thief left a clue behind the door.

leave no stone unturned.mean: to try everything possible to do something
leave no stone unturned.ex: Amit left no stone unturned to pass the exam.

left out in the cold.mean: ignored or not included by others
left out in the cold.ex: Neha felt left out in the cold at the party.

left, right and centre.ex: Firecrackers burst left, right and centre on Diwali.

lend an ear.ex: Sita lent an ear to her friend's problems.

less value for money.ex: That samosa was less value for money.

let the cat out of the bag.mean: to tell a secret by mistake
let the cat out of the bag.ex: Rohan let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.

let the dust settle.ex: Wait and let the dust settle before arguing.

life and death.mean: a very serious and dangerous situation
life and death.ex: The accident was a life and death moment.

life full of quarrels.mean: always fighting, no peace at home
life full of quarrels.ex: Ramu had a life full of quarrels.

lift a heavy load.mean: to pick up something very heavy
lift a heavy load.ex: Ramu helps lift a heavy load at the market.

light colours.mean: soft and pale colors like pink, sky blue
light colours.ex: Sita wore light colours for the party.

like a bat out of hell.mean: very fast, in a big hurry
like a bat out of hell.ex: Rohit ran like a bat out of hell.

like a cakewalk.mean: very easy to do, no difficulty
like a cakewalk.ex: The math paper was like a cakewalk.

like fish out of water.mean: feeling uncomfortable in a new place
like fish out of water.ex: New student felt like fish out of water.

like someone immediately.mean: to feel friendly with someone at first sight
like someone immediately.ex: I liked my new teacher immediately.

like to tell long stories.mean: enjoys speaking for a long time
like to tell long stories.ex: Grandma likes to tell long stories at night.

like to tell short stories.mean: enjoys speaking in short and quick way
like to tell short stories.ex: Raju likes to tell short stories to friends.

little by little.mean: slowly in small amounts over time
little by little.ex: Rahul saved money little by little for a new bat.

lively and energetic.mean: very active with lots of energy
lively and energetic.ex: Anu is lively and energetic during the school play.

loaves and fishes.mean: personal gain or selfish profit from something
loaves and fishes.ex: The politician only cared for his loaves and fishes.

lock, stock and barrel.ex: Father sold the old house lock, stock and barrel.

long held desire.mean: a wish you kept for many years
long held desire.ex: Buying a bicycle was Priya's long held desire.

look down upon.mean: to think someone is less important
look down upon.ex: Never look down upon poor people.

look out.bn: সাবধান হওয়া, বিপদ থেকে সতর্ক থাকা
look out.ex: Look out! The car is coming very fast.

look sharp.ex: We must look sharp or we will miss the train.

looking at the stars.mean: staring up into the night sky
looking at the stars.ex: Raju loves looking at the stars with his grandfather.

loose the ground.mean: to lose grip, to slip away
loose the ground.ex: The horse loosened the ground and the rider fell.

lose heart.mean: to feel hopeless and give up hope
lose heart.ex: Don't lose heart if you fail the exam once.

lose your marbles.bn: বোকা বা পাগলের মতো হয়ে যাওয়া
lose your marbles.ex: Uncle acted so weird, we thought he lost his marbles.

lost the urge to speak.mean: felt too shocked or sad to talk
lost the urge to speak.ex: On hearing the bad news, he lost the urge to speak.

lump sum.mean: full money paid at one time, not in parts
lump sum.ex: Father paid the school fees in a lump sum.

left out in cold.ex: Ankit felt left out in cold when friends played without him.
